PROP-attendanceze-inv-033.text: STEM OAuth token exchange must include client_secret only in server-side POST, not in URL.
PROP-attendanceze-inv-033.assertion: forall token_req: client_secret in req.body && client_secret not in req.url

locations.note: Uses request.formData() (line 18) to receive client_secret (line 24). HTTP method is POST only. client_secret is never read from URL params or searchParams.
